prompt: A vibrant and crowded market stall at a desert oasis. The stall is overflowing with goods. Woven baskets are filled to the brim with colorful spices, mounds of dried fruit, and shiny dates. Large clay pots hold figs and various nuts. Rolls of brightly colored fabric are stacked high, next to a beautiful brass teapot and a hanging metal lantern. A small, intricately patterned rug is displayed for sale. Several handmade leather pouches and a pair of simple sandals are arranged on a wooden crate. A trader is demonstrating a wooden flute. Strings of colorful beads hang from the stall's awning. In the corner sits an ornate hookah pipe and a decorative camel saddle. A full water skin is hung on a post. A single, beautifully painted ceramic tile is propped up against a hand mirror. This is a traditional market, so modern conveniences are absent. There is no refrigerator to keep things cool, goods are not sealed in plastic wrap, and there is no price scanner or credit card machine for transactions. Despite the sun, no one is using a modern umbrella, and the traders tell time by the sun, not a wrist watch.
